name: square
title: Square
summary: Payments, refunds, customers, locations and catalog under /v2 with Square's error envelope, payment.created and customer.created webhooks, and card-declined, generic-decline, rate-limit and outage scenarios.

upstream.notes: api.json (release 2026-09-16, OpenAPI 3.0) is pinned for provenance but `replaces` is unset so `init --full` stays off: the file references schemas it does not define (#/components/schemas/AppFeeAllocation and CurrencyExchange; every release since 2025-10 has a similar dangling $ref), and Mockingbird refuses to compile it ('unresolvable $ref'). It also declares only 200 responses, so the scenarios' 400/402/429 would not apply to it. The subset keeps its operation ids (CreatePayment, ListCustomers, ...). Real webhooks are signed with x-square-hmacsha256-signature = base64(HMAC-SHA256(key, notification URL + body)), which Mockingbird does not produce; the example signs with hmac-sha256 instead.
